verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a native HubSpot, Salesforce, or Attio integration, and never mentions syncing notes or summaries onto contact or deal records. The only related items are developer building blocks: a GraphQL API with an attendee-email filter, webhooks, and a Zapier webhook connector. A user could use these to build CRM sync, but none of them is the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)
